items.title: ‘We Screwed Up’: DoorDash Stock Rises After Admitting It Underpaid Tipped Workers
items.summary: Food delivery service  DoorDash  has settled a dispute with New York City over claims it underpaid its tipped workers.  Investors are likely breathing a sigh of relief that the company settled the matter for the relatively modest total amount of $131.5 million, most of which goes directly to the workers who were underpaid or paid late.  More than 200,000 Dashers, as the firm’s delivery workers are called, will receive the payments.

items.title: DoorDash settles $131.5 million NYC delivery worker pay probe
items.summary: The $131.5 million agreement with New York City includes $12.3 million for workers who were underpaid or paid late and a $16.7 million fine

items.title: DoorDash to Pay $131.5 Million to Resolve NYC Investigation Into Minimum-Pay Law Compliance
items.summary: The company said that the settlement includes $12.3 million in direct payments to delivery drivers on its platform.

items.title: DoorDash Retains Lowest-Cost Delivery Position Despite Fee Increases, Wells Fargo Finds
items.summary: DoorDash (NYSE:DASH) remained the lowest-cost third-party delivery provider in the third quarter, according to a Wells Fargo pricing survey released on Tuesday, despite recording the largest quarterly fee increase among the platforms compared. The survey found that DoorDash’s total basket costs were approximately 2% below those of Uber (NYSE:UBER) and Instacart, even as its fees increased 3.

items.title: What Does Costco Wholesale (COST) Nationwide Same Day Delivery Mean For Members?
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) has rolled out nationwide same-day delivery across the U.S. through DoorDash for its members. The expanded arrangement now covers all U.S. Costco warehouses, giving shoppers access to thousands of items for rapid fulfillment. DoorDash will handle orders placed via its app and website.
